checks.note: The short_clips fact reports all seven segments narrated in English, Spanish and Mandarin, with the longest narration 33.92 s (Mandarin segment 6) against the 35 s ceiling; the longest running time, 36.32 s for that same segment, is the title card and pauses the rubric allows. The chapter rails in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png list all seven chapters with per-chapter times, none longer than 0:36.

The no_owl fact searched 18 files and found no matches. In all six guide screenshots the panels are anatomy and the surgical site: the head bandage in place, the bandage being pulled off, the incision behind the ear, and a magnified view of the incision with tape strips. No owl, mascot or character appears anywhere a patient looks.

The narrator fact reports one narrator voice for each of the three narrated languages and no character. The screenshots show a narrated player with a transcript and no talking character on screen; the languages fact confirms per-language audio (es and zh-Hans audio files with matching audio_language).

The subtitles fact lists captions for all seven segments in English, Spanish and Mandarin. At desktop width the caption band under the picture carries the current cue with the spoken word highlighted, readable in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png, with a Captions/Subtítulos/字幕 checkbox on. At 375 px the transcript under the player is the caption track and highlights the spoken word, as the rubric describes, and it is legible in guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png. One thing to watch, not a failure: the English and Spanish bands show a partial cue ("Two days after surgery, remove the mastoid"; "Dos días después de la cirugía,") where the Mandarin band holds the whole sentence, so the English cue break lands mid-phrase between "the mastoid" and "dressing".

The toc fact lists seven chapters, and each one landed exactly at its expected start (0, 12.4, 37.44, 61.92, 77.68, 101.28, 129.36 s) with the right chapter active; every chapter is visible at 1280x800 in all three languages. The desktop screenshots show the full numbered rail with titles and times, and the phone screenshots show a chapter stepper ("CHAPTER 1 OF 7" / "CAPÍTULO 1 DE 7" / "章节 1 / 7") with back, forward and a dropdown.

The languages fact shows Spanish and Mandarin each loading that language's title, audio file and expected first sentence. guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png are wholly in their language, including the chrome (Idioma, Imprimir la tarjeta, Subtítulos; 语言, 打印卡片, 字幕) and the chapter titles and transcript; no English leaks into either page. guide-from-link.png opens in Spanish from the link's l=es.

The provider_file fact measures 34 ms from pasting the block to a patient link, two steps, zero account or login fields and no network requests after load, so the clinic minute is easily met with no app and no account. provider-filled.png shows the four asked-for rows, Antibiotic, Pain medication, Follow-up and Language, each reading "your block" with an overriding control beside it (Yes/No toggles set to No and Yes, the date 10/01/2026, Español) and plain text saying what the guide will say; "Open this patient's guide" is live. provider-draft.png shows the same table for the unfilled dot phrase: the Follow-up preset ("Use 'about two weeks'") and the language chooser are offered, and the rows the page cannot read say so and ask the provider to choose rather than guessing a medication, with "A line you leave out uses its preset" stated under the box.

The review_line fact shows a single line in the block, "Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***", no clinician badge, and no review date in the link; the link fragment in provider_file is #a=0&p=1&f=2026-10-01&l=es, which carries no reviewer. Both provider screenshots say plainly "Stays in your note. The patient's guide shows no reviewer line" and "Not shown to the patient, and not carried in the link." guide-from-link-badges.png, the patient guide scrolled to the end of the transcript, shows no reviewer line or badge, matching that promise despite the screenshot's older caption.

The card_summary fact reports the card served 200 and on the first screen at both widths. "Print the card" sits in the desktop header in guide-en-desktop.png (and as Imprimir la tarjeta / 打印卡片 in the other two), and on phone it is one tap away in the first screen beside the speed control in guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png.
